subject: Pipeline Lock Week — inputs for leadership review pack and final stage updates
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Pipeline Lock Week — inputs for leadership review pack and final stage updates

Team,

Quick one: this week is our scheduled Pipeline Lock Week. We need a clean, leadership-ready exec pack by EOW Friday (dec 4) and a stage-accurate commit column for the QBR. Please prioritize the following: 

1) Stage updates: update the "commit" vs "best-case" flag in commit_tracker.xlsx for any active deals. Commit must be deals you can reasonably contract-sign within FY/Q.
2) Notes: add 1-2 line blockers in the tracker if legal/procurement/privacy is outstanding.
3) Deck inputs: use exec_pack_template.pptx and drop a 1-slide deal highlight for any >$250k ARR opportunities.
4) Attach artifacts: upload customer contracts/POs to the Drive folder and add links in the tracker.

Attachments (in this thread): commit_tracker.xlsx, exec_pack_template.pptx, open_deal_list.csv

Deadlines: stage updates by Wed 12/2 6pm PT; slides + evidentiary docs by Thu 12/3 12pm PT.

I'll run a 30m sync Thu 3:00pm PT to review the pack — calendar invite to follow. If you cannot meet the stage deadline, flag here immediately so we can reassign.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pipeline Lock Week — inputs for leadership review pack and final stage updates

Ack — thanks Rishi.

I'll push my AE book updates into commit_tracker.xlsx today and upload stage_notes_laura.docx with brief legal/procurement blockers for Deal IDs: DW-9852, DW-9876.

Quick Q: for DW-9876 (Acme), procurement indicated they may require a PO and an SOW before signature. Do we mark that as "commit" or "best-case"?

- Laura

Subject: Re: Pipeline Lock Week — inputs for leadership review pack and final stage updates

Agree with Laura's note. For clarity: our definition of commit for the leadership pack is sales-led commitment where procurement/legal steps are on the critical path but the customer has signaled exec approval and budget hold. If procurement requires a PO + SOW and that could push sign beyond the quarter, mark as "best-case".

I'll update DW-9876 to "best-case" if the PO timeline is uncertain; marking a commit where PO is outstanding has historically skewed our forecast.

— Monica

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, markus.klein@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Request: brief leadership sync and procurement timeline for Acme (DW-9876)

Sara / Tom —

Following up on our opportunity DW-9876. We're preparing our leadership review pack this week and want to represent your expected timeline accurately. Two quick asks:

1) Can you confirm whether Acme will provide a PO (and estimated issuance date) or if you will sign an SOW directly?
2) Would you be available for a 20-minute alignment call Thu 12/3 at 4:00pm PT to confirm any outstanding items so we don't over/under-state timelines to my leadership?

I've attached a draft exec pack slide for your reference (exec_pack_draft.pdf) — feel free to correct any customer-facing wording.

If you prefer procurement to coordinate, I've CC'd procurement@acmeanalytics.com.

Thanks,
Rishi
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachments: exec_pack_draft.pdf

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com, grace.oconnor@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: sara.holt@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Finalize: pipeline lock confirmed — QBR pack and next steps

All —

Thanks for the quick turn. We are locking the pipeline for the leadership pack at 6pm PT Thu (12/3). Items for the final pass:

- Laura: confirm DW-9876 as "best-case" unless Acme confirms PO issuance before 12/10.
- Monica: include a 1-line risk summary for any deals >$250k where procurement/legal is outstanding.
- Grace: consolidate the slides into exec_pack_template.pptx and run the single-slide highlights for the five top deals.
- Aditya: run the deck for consistency and export PDF for exec distribution.

Attachments present in the folder will be referenced in the leadership pack. If any team cannot meet the lock, escalate here before 5pm PT so we can assign remediation resources.

Markus Klein
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
